notes: Model covers both NP-PA1705UL-B (black) and NP-PA1705UL-W (white) color variants; specs are identical between colors. This is a lens-interchangeable installation projector sold body-only (projection lens is a separate accessory, e.g. NP51ZL-NP56ZL), and is not rack-mountable (no rackUnits set; it is a table/ceiling-mount unit, 599 x 230/238 x 490 mm, 28.7 kg). Primary source used: Sharp NEC Display Solutions' official English User's Manual (PA1705UL_manual_EN_v3.pdf), "Terminal Panel Features" section (part names) and "3-1. Specifications" table (input/output connectors, power). Cross-checked against ProjectorCentral's NEC PA1705UL-B spec page and Sharp NEC's own sharpnecdisplays.us/business.sharpusa.com product-highlights copy (via search snippets; the live product pages redirected/404'd during fetch, so those URLs could not be used directly as sourceUrl). HDMI version is not printed literally as "2.0" in the manual text — it lists "Type A x2, Deep Color, LipSync, HDCP, 4K" — the hdmi-2.0 grade is inferred from the documented 4K/HDCP2.2 feature set and matches third-party spec aggregators (ProjectorCentral, search snippets) that explicitly list "HDMI 2.0". HDBaseT ports are graded eth-100m because the manual specifies control operates over 100BASE-TX; actual HDBaseT video throughput exceeds typical RJ45 grades and doesn't map cleanly onto the Ethernet grade scale, so treat this grade as a rough proxy rather than a literal link-speed rating. The AC IN connector's exact IEC sub-type (most likely C19/C20 given current draw) is not explicitly named in either the user manual or the installation manual text extracted; this is the largest confidence gap. USB port is control-only (mouse input, and provides 5V/1.4A power out) rather than a general host/data port, but is coded bidirectional per the connector-type convention for USB-A.

ports.name: HDMI 1 IN
ports.note: Type A, Deep Color, HDCP 2.2/1.4, supports 4K signal

ports.name: HDMI 2 IN
ports.note: Type A, Deep Color, HDCP 2.2/1.4, supports 4K signal

ports.name: HDBaseT IN
ports.note: Video/audio/control input, 100BASE-TX, Deep Color, HDCP 2.2/1.4, 4K; also used for daisy-chaining

ports.name: HDBaseT OUT
ports.note: Outputs incoming HDMI1/HDMI2/HDBaseT IN signal for daisy-chain to another HDBaseT receiver/projector

ports.name: AUDIO OUT
ports.note: Stereo mini jack, common to all input signals

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Type A, for USB mouse menu navigation; 5.0V/1.4A power supply. Not a general data-transfer host port

ports.name: REMOTE
ports.note: Stereo mini jack, wired remote control input

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Detachable 3-pin power cord terminal with cable clamp/stopper. Manual does not print the exact IEC sub-type; C19/C20-class inferred because rated input current (12.8A @ 100-130V) exceeds the 10A limit of C13/C14, and the printed power-cord spec requires '15A or higher'.
